description: This PHP class 'PunchOutController' handles the logic for punching out employees in the OrangeHRM Attendance module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes attendance and authorization traits to manage attendance records and user authentication state. The preRender method checks the last punch-in record and directs the user to punch in if no record is found, otherwise, it prepares a Vue component with relevant attendance data.

classes.name: PunchOutController
classes.description: Controller for managing the punch out process, extending basic Vue controller functionalities, handling attendance record checks and preparing the Vue component for punch out actions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the data and component for the punch out view, checking previous punch records and setting up the Vue component accordingly.
